claims.detail: Klein describes itself as the only major tool manufacturer worldwide focused on electrical and utility applications.
claims.evidence_snippet: Klein is the only major tool manufacturer worldwide focused on electrical and utility applications.

claims.detail: Future planned investments in excess of $100 million are intended to support USA manufacturing of currently sourced products and new USA-made products.
claims.evidence_snippet: Future planned investments in excess of $100 million will allow us to manufacture in the USA some of the products we currently source as well as make new USA-made products that would otherwise be imported without this investment.

claims.detail: Klein has invested in four new US manufacturing facilities in the past decade.
claims.evidence_snippet: We have invested in four new US manufacturing facilities in the past decade, and have invested heavily in new equipment and tooling in our plants to expand our capacity and quality.

claims.detail: Klein states that it sources some products abroad.
claims.evidence_snippet: Like most global companies, we do source some products abroad, but Klein Tools makes 14 times more products here in the United States than we do in any other country.

claims.detail: Klein lists a Mansfield, Texas distribution center that also manufactures screwdrivers, nut drivers, and fish tapes.
claims.evidence_snippet:

claims.detail: Klein operates plants in multiple US locations and a plant in Mexico City.
claims.evidence_snippet:
Klein Tools operates the following plants in the U.S.:

claims.detail: Klein states that it is expanding throughout the world while selling products made in the USA.
claims.evidence_snippet: We live in an international business environment and Klein is expanding throughout the world selling products that are made in the USA.
